correctness.rationale: The exact domination criterion is that each test triple contains a selected pair, equivalently the complementary two-shadow is triangle-free. At three selected triples Mantel equality forces the two-shadow K3 disjoint union K4; one triangle for K3 and at least three for K4 are needed. Independently enumerated exclusions by test triples that meet every proposed center in at most one point; all four-sets not excluded are exactly the distinct 140 Type I and 630 Type II configurations. Adjacent transpositions on the ground set generate the two claimed orbits. Calculated reconfiguration from pairwise overlap, not by replaying the bundled move loops. The exact slide-edge set equals the 35 disjoint thickened K4 constructions, with eccentricities 2:140 and 3:630. The jump graph is connected, all 770 eccentricities are seven, and the degrees are twelve and six in the respective types. All 630 extra edges map to the 70 disjoint-owner pairs with multiplicity nine each. The full D/S/J certificate matches byte-for-byte.
residual_risks: Exact for J(7,3) and the two stipulated fixed-cardinality move rules only; the replay is a proof by finite exhaustion, not a family theorem.
